purpose: Close four reviewed exchange candidates after promotion through D-1000 BX29.

entries.notes: BX29 promotes CoinCatch as dead after direct path checks and first-party evidence for the 2025-12-24 termination announcement, 2026-01-30 cessation of platform operations, and subsequent final wind-down.
BX29 promotes Zoomex as one hybrid entity after current first-party CEX and wallet-based DEX review plus independent current centralized market and volume verification.
BX29 promotes P2B after direct P2B and P2PB2B identity checks, current first-party exchange review, and independent current market and volume verification.

BX29 promotes M2 as limited after current first-party spot and OTC product review and independent exchange recognition. Untracked current market volume and separate global and ADGM legal-entity scopes prevent active classification.
